# @aponiajs/view

> Template view rendering pipeline for AponiaJS.

## Exports

- `ViewModule`: dynamic module configuring the view engine
- `ViewService`: service for programmatic template rendering
- `VIEW_ENGINE`: injection token for custom view engines
- `HtmlViewEngine`: zero-dependency fast template substitution engine
- Types: `ViewEngine`, `ViewModuleOptions`

- [Package README](README.md)
- [Published packages](../../docs/packages.md)
